Container.Name: flipdesk
Container.Overview: A self-hosted, web-based inventory and accounting application for eBay resellers: automatic eBay sync, real profit tracking, inventory, end-and-relist / repricing / delayed-promotion automations, error detection, expense and mileage ledger, income statement and a Schedule C–style tax report. One Docker container, your own eBay developer keys.
Container.Requires: Reverse Proxy setup for external access in order for eBay to send marketplace account deletion notifications
